notes.ultra: drawn in place of the lower tiers' platform, base, mat, posts, pads and ropes, the hall's floor, walkways, stands, crowd, screens' boxes and lighting truss (fight_gfx.StageVisual); the markings, the logo, the open edge's glow, the fire jets, spikes and ice, the screens' lettering and the energy shots as the lower tiers draw them
notes.materials: colour null: the ring's mat colour, MAT_COLOURS[ring % 6]; "corner": CORNER_COLOURS[ring % 3]; "rope": the ropes' colour (red 0.85, 0.12, 0.1; electric ropes 0.5, 0.8, 1.0 glowing 0.3, 0.9, 2.6 and pulsing, as the lower tiers'); flat or far: casts no shadow
